newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares eye U.S. for direction.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares eye U.S. for direction.

text.p: Belgian shares ended firmer on Tuesday, though below the day's highs after Wall Street turned negative during the afternoon in Europe.

Nevertheless a partial recovery in the U.S. market after the Belgian bourse closed gave some encouragement for positive sentiment again on Wednesday. The Dow was just four points lower at 5,729 after falling to 5,712 earlier amid profit-taking.

The Bel-20 index .BFX finished 9.95 points or 0.57 percent higher at 1,755.62, after peaking at 1,763.01, with a good 2.3 billion Belgian francs traded. Continued strength in the dollar underpinned particularly U.S. exposed stocks.

Generale Bank will be the focus of attention on Wednesday after the bank, Belgium's biggest, said after the market closed Tuesday that first half 1996 group net profit rose 8.6 percent to 7.31 billion Belgian francs.
The figure was less than some analysts expected.
The bank also said it planned at one-for-10 capital increase worth about 15 billion francs.
Generale Bank shares closed 100 francs up at 11,325 on Wednesday.
